summary.text: Charlie Shepherd represents Idaho House District 7, Seat B, and lives in Pollock; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a third term and lists a maintenance supervisor occupation.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Shepherd was raised in Garden Valley, Idaho, graduated from Salmon River High School in Riggins, and is maintenance supervisor at the Salmon River Joint School District.

The biography adds that Shepherd spent 10 years logging in four states, worked 15 years for a family-owned sawmill and log home business, and coached high school sports at Salmon River High School for 18 years.
